messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
People around you are stressed: Tom Bradley. The mood is tense.

CareRide of the Valley called Grace back this tick — a dispatcher named Marcus Webb reached out to schedule a formal onboarding orientation and background check for next week, citing her NEMT certification and clean record as exactly what they need for a new Millfield General route they are launching. Millfield Medical Transport has not yet responded, but Marcus at CareRide told her the orientation-to-first-route timeline is typically five to seven days once paperwork clears. Robert Jackson responded to Grace's text with the name of his direct contact at CareRide — ironically the same Marcus Webb who already called — and confirmed the operator is actively expanding. Grace drove morning airport windows and one Friday surge block, generating approximately $380 in rideshare income this tick, which partially offsets the $1,787 monthly burn while onboarding finalizes.
